verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a notarization and incorporation service, so the axis applies. The pack documents no first-party 'export all my data' capability. What it does show is per-record API retrieval (GET incorporation details) and downloading a generated ELSTER XML for a tax registration. These are developer building blocks and single-artifact downloads, not a bulk, open-format export for leaving the service.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
